name: Startup Fame

sources.title: Startup Fame pricing — Verified (free, badge) / Highlight $19/mo / Spotlight $149/mo

conditions: Free 'Verified' plan requires a Startup Fame badge on your homepage, checked by their verification bot
Free listings are reviewed and published within ~7 days
requirements: Account required — the dashboard and submit flow sit behind /login
Homepage (not just any page) badge placement for the free plan
Startup suitable for a reviewed DR 80+ directory
preparation: Startup name, tagline, description, visuals, category
Badge HTML placed on the homepage before/with submission (bot verifies)
Decide Verified (free) vs Highlight $19/mo vs Spotlight $149/mo — paid plans skip badge and publish in <30s
workflow: Create an account / log in (submit CTAs route through /login?plan=Verified)
Submit the startup from the dashboard
Add the Startup Fame badge to your homepage
Verification bot checks the badge; team reviews within ~7 days
Startup gets a dedicated page with do-follow backlinks and a 'Featured' badge asset
watchFor: Badge must go on the HOMEPAGE specifically, and their bot verifies it — footer-only subpages may not count
Highlight/Spotlight are subscriptions, not one-time — cancel from the Promote page
Dofollow link persists only while the startup stays listed (Verified after approval, or while a paid plan is active) — no 'lifetime' claim
Positioning is quality-over-volume: they explicitly discourage bulk directory submissions
countsAsLive: A dedicated startup page under startupfa.me/s/<slug> listed in /startups with a dofollow outbound link.
unknowns: Whether rejections happen after badge verification
